item.title: Tension and clashes as hundreds of thousands protest again in France
item.description: Authorities say 320,000 march on third consecutive weekend of demonstrations over cost of living and state of schools. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Police clash with masked rioters after largely peaceful protests across France
item.description: Demonstrations also taking place in Germany, where officers fire teargas to disperse crowds as evening falls Clashes have erupted in Paris, Marseille and other cities after tens of thousands of demonstrators, some in Halloween fancy dress, marched across France in a third wave of protests over the cost of living and deteriorating public services. About 320,000 people – down from an estimated 410,000 last weekend – took part in rallies around the country, the interior ministry said, including 70,000 in Paris who marched along boulevards on the south-eastern outskirts, avoiding the city centre… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Clashes break out at France’s Halloween protests, as hundreds of thousands take to streets
item.description: Police fired tear gas and clashed with protesters in Paris and elsewhere on Saturday as hundreds of thousands marched across France against soaring living costs and police violence, with some demonstrators dressed as clowns and witches for Halloween. While the third consecutive weekend of nationwide protests was largely peaceful, tensions erupted in several cities later Saturday. After a march on the outskirts of Paris in bright sunshine, clashes broke out between police and some demonstrators... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
